name: k_hop_neighborhood
author: 3f28ff34
description: Finds every node within k steps (hops) of a given node, using breadth-first search. Use it for questions like 'who is within two step/hops of X', 'friends of friends of X', or 'which airports can I reach from X with at most one stop' (k hops = at most k-1 stops in between). Works on all graphs; on directed graphs it follows outgoing edges only, and edge weights are ignored (every edge is one hop). Needs a node id, not a name: call lookup_node first. Returns count (the total number of nodes found, excluding the start node), the nearest top_k nodes with id, label and hop distance, and result_graph_id: a subgraph of the start node plus every node found, which other tools can run on next.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Id of the start node, e.g. 'MAA' or 'm1'. Not a name: use lookup_node to find the id.

k.description: Number of hops: the largest distance included. k=1 gives direct neighbours, k=2 adds their neighbours too.

top_k.description: How many of the nearest nodes to list. count and result_graph_id always cover all nodes found.
